label: Artifacts and Thopters (Sai, Master Thopterist): imprint and copying a card's power and toughness (Duplicant); base power and toughness and forced attacks (Graaz); reselecting a defender (Misleading Signpost); counters with a threshold that exile (Mazemind Tome); X-cost board wipes by mana value (Steel Hellkite)

cards.name: Adaptive Omnitool
gaps: Whenever equipped creature attacks, look at the top six cards of your library.
You may reveal an artifact card from among them and put it into your hand.
Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Aether Spellbomb
gaps: {U}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return target creature to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Duplicant
gaps: Imprint — When this creature enters, you may exile target nontoken creature.
As long as a card exiled with this creature is a creature card, this creature has the power, toughness, and creature types of the last creature card exiled with it.
It's still a Shapeshifter.

cards.name: Fall from Favor
gaps: When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature and you become the monarch.
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step unless that player is the monarch.

cards.name: Foundry of the Consuls
gaps: {5}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Create two 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying.

cards.name: Graaz, Unstoppable Juggernaut
gaps: Juggernauts you control attack each combat if able.
Juggernauts you control can't be blocked by Walls.
Other creatures you control have base power and toughness 5/3 and are Juggernauts in addition to their other creature types.

cards.name: Kappa Cannoneer
gaps: Whenever this creature or another artifact you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
It can't be blocked this turn.

cards.name: Launch Mishap
gaps: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell.
Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.

cards.name: Master Transmuter
gaps: {U}, {T}, Return an artifact you control to its owner's hand: You may put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Mazemind Tome
gaps: {T}, Put a page counter on this artifact: Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
{2}, {T}, Put a page counter on this artifact: Draw a card.
When there are four or more page counters on this artifact, exile it.
If you do, you gain 4 life.

cards.name: Mind's Eye
gaps: Whenever an opponent draws a card, you may pay {1}.
If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: Misleading Signpost
gaps: When this artifact enters during the declare attackers step, you may reselect which player or permanent target attacking creature is attacking. (It can't attack its controller or their permanents.)

cards.name: Nettlecyst
gaps: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.

cards.name: Nevinyrral's Disk
gaps: {1}, {T}: Destroy all artifacts, creatures, and enchantments.

cards.name: Research Thief
gaps: Whenever an artifact creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.

cards.name: Shimmer Dragon
gaps: As long as you control four or more artifacts, this creature has hexproof. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
Tap two untapped artifacts you control: Draw a card.

cards.name: Soul-Guide Lantern
gaps: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile each opponent's graveyard.

cards.name: Spire Golem
gaps: Affinity for Islands (This spell costs {1} less to cast for each Island you control.)

cards.name: Steel Hellkite
gaps: {X}: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X whose controller was dealt combat damage by this creature this turn.
Activate only once each turn.

cards.name: Tamiyo's Logbook
gaps: {5}{U}, {T}: Draw a card.
This ability costs {1} less to activate for each other artifact you control.

cards.name: Thirst for Knowledge
gaps: Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.

cards.name: Thopter Fabricator
gaps: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
